value.rationale: The claim gives a complete exact phase classification of a natural translate-based centrality functional on all products of simplices, including a surprising extreme-dimension bottleneck reduction and changing median-set dimension. In the 3D triangular prism, the sharp scales 2/3 and 8/9 switch the controlling factor, leaving a unique median only at the isolated crossing between a line segment and a two-dimensional simplex of medians. It is not a routine extension of a pointwise simplex value: it resolves the product minimax envelope and geometric structure.
